sources.label: Custom Patches for Chess.com with offline Stockfish 16.1 integration, puzzle sys
sources.author: Prathxm
patch_list: Ad-Free
Removes advertisements
Clone Chess.com
Changes the package name to com.chess.prathxm, allowing the patched app to be installed side-by-side with the original Chess.com app.
Custom Titles
Fetches and applies custom titles for users from a remote database. DM PrathxmOp to get yours for fun lol!
Global Crash Handler
Catches uncaught exceptions and displays a custom crash screen with details to report issues.
Lichess Puzzles
Loads daily puzzles from Lichess and bypasses Chess.com puzzle premium limits.
Local Stockfish Analysis
Enables local Stockfish engine for post-game review & analysis.
Unlimited Play Coach
Removes the one-free-game-per-day limit on Play Coach.
Unlock All Bots
Unlocks all premium and restricted bots in the Versus Bots feature.

sources.label: My Morphe patches for the apps I use, in one source for Morphe Manager.
sources.author: Noam
patch_list: Accent color
Your own colour in place of chess.com's green, chosen in Noam's Patches → Accent color: buttons, highlights, icons and text of the app.
AMOLED black
Pure black backgrounds instead of chess.com's dark grey, in the newer and the older screens. Switch it in Noam's Patches (then restart the app).
Arcade animations

Adds the chess.com website's Arcade piece animations to every board: light trails, bursts when a piece is picked up, dropped or captured, a flash on check, outlined last-move squares and animated move hints. Switch it in Noam's Patches.
Arrows in games

Adds Arrows and Clear buttons to the game bars (live, daily, archived, pass and play, bots, coach). While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move.
Board colors
Choose the board's square colours: your own, or one of chess.com's colour themes, on every board of the app. In Noam's Patches → Board colors.
Clone Chess.com
Renames the app to com.chess.noam so it installs next to the real Chess.com app instead of over it. Leave it off to keep updating your current install.
Customize bottom bar
Choose the tabs between Home and More (Puzzles, Learn, Watch, Bots, Train) and their order, in Noam's Patches → Bottom bar.
Customize Home screen
Choose which tiles and sections the Home screen shows, and the order of the tiles. Works on both of chess.com's Home screens (the older list and the redesign).
Hide Premium-only content

Free accounts no longer see what only Premium members can use: Premium-only bots are not listed, and the Premium toolbar button, the Home and More banners and the Settings Upgrade row, the Home diamond, the sale banner and More's Membershi…
Lichess Puzzles

Puzzles from Lichess becomes the Puzzles tab's big button, with chess.com's Solve Puzzles above it. Lichess's puzzles play in chess.com's own puzzle screen (board, coach, sounds), rated on the phone the way Lichess rates them; nothing is s…
Limits as toasts

When a free limit is reached (Game Review, puzzles, lessons, drills, videos…) a short toast says so instead of a full-screen Premium offer, and promotional pop-ups are not shown. Nothing is unlocked: the limits stay exactly as they are.
No ads

Banner, full-screen and game-over ads are not loaded or shown, and neither are their Remove Ads links: the app's own "ads enabled" state and the account's show-ads flag, which are off for members, stay off.
No rating prompts
The app doesn't ask you to rate it on Google Play. Switch it in Noam's Patches.
Noam's Patches settings
Adds a Noam's Patches row at the top of the More tab, where the other patches of this bundle are switched on and off. Patches you did not select do not show up there.
Stockfish analysis

Stockfish 19 on your phone, offline (arm64): best-move arrows on finished games, the analysis boards, the game explorer and Game Review (in a Lichess review, on the moves Lichess didn't mark), and an eval bar where chess.com has none of it…
Time controls under a minute
The custom time slider goes below one minute: 10, 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds, with or without increment, the way the website allows. Labels read "30 sec" and "0:30+1".
Unlimited Game Review

Game Review asks who reviews the game: chess.com, Lichess's servers (online, with your Lichess account) or, with the Stockfish analysis patch, Stockfish on your phone (offline, no daily limit). The phone and Lichess judge moves the Lichess…
Unlimited Play Coach
Removes the one-free-game-per-day limit on Play Coach, a bot-only practice mode.
Unlock all bots
Every bot in Versus Bots can be played, including ones only Premium members may play.
Unlock Premium content

The app's own premium-tier check always answers with the top tier, so content gated on it (lessons, drills, insights, themes, puzzle-rush extras and anything else that reads the account's tier) treats the account as a member. The server st…
